source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Qatar 2026 Adidas Home Kit
source.note: Kit maker. Named-press kit write-up: the shirt carries the QFA crest and adidas marks only, with 'Qatar' in Arabic on the upper back and matching maroon shorts; no commercial sponsor on any placement. GOAL's kit guide (2026-06-24) likewise describes only the crest and Three Stripes.
source.quote: Qatar have released their Home football kit for the 2026-2028 cycle, with adidas presenting a design

summary: adidas home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle. No commercial shirt sponsors: kit-press write-ups describe only the QFA crest, adidas branding and 'Qatar' in Arabic on the upper back.
